messages:
maria: Quick sync — need alignment on how we prioritize pricing/packaging asks: reserved capacity vs pay-as-you-go, rate limits/tiers, and sequencing. I want a simple playbook we can run on new requests.
ajay: +1. Recommend RICE for platform-level bets, impact vs effort (fast sanity) for tactical asks.
lucy: Customers keep asking for predictability. enterprise sales wants reserved capacity + clearer burst rules. small apps prefer PAYG.
samir: From finance: reserved gives ARR visibility but increases ops risk. We should set a min commitment threshold.
product-bot: Quick poll created: "Use RICE for major initiatives?" react :thumbsup: yes / :thumbsdown: no — please vote.
maria: Here's a proposed playbook draft: 1) Triage (impact/effort quick filter). 2) If >threshold, full RICE. 3) Define launch criteria (SLA, billing, docs, 2 pilot customers). 4) Sequence: flexible tiers -> rate limits -> reserved. Thoughts?
ajay: Sounds good. For RICE, let's standardize scales and units: Reach = estimated % of requests/customers in quarter; Impact = 0.25 (minimal) to 3 (massive); Confidence = %; Effort = eng-months. Score = (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort.
maria: Agreed. Add shipping guardrails: must have console support + e2e perf tests before GA.
lucy: Pilot customers: @acme-health, @scribeapp are interested in reserved trials. They'll test throughput and billing.
samir: Financial thresholds suggestion: Reserved = min $25k/month commit or 12-month contract; otherwise offer tiered discounts at smaller commits.
ajay: Technical constraints: dedicated pools require capacity planning + autoscaler rule changes. Doable but needs 4-6 weeks of infra work for MVP.
product-bot: Note: Prioritized backlog updated with tags: pricing, reserved-capacity, rate-limits.
devx-bot: Recommend shipping developer docs + quickstart for reserved -> reduces onboarding time by ~40% in past rollouts.
maria: Sequencing proposal: 1) Launch flexible pricing + clearer rate-limit tiers (2 weeks). 2) Rate-limit burst credits + docs (4 weeks). 3) Reserved capacity MVP (6-8 weeks, pilot customers). 4) SLA + enterprise billing features (post-pilot, gating for GA).
lucy: Sales ok with that sequence if we lock pilot terms. I'll coordinate pilot contracts. :+1:
samir: We'll model ARR sensitivity for both sequences. Ask: what's expected conversion rate from pilot -> GA? Need conservative estimates for forecasting.
ajay: For launch criteria for reserved: infra load test passed, canary in 2 regions, automated failover, billing flow + refund/overage rules documented.
maria: Good list. For prioritization thresholds: if quick triage impact>0.8 and effort<2 eng-months -> do as tactical; else run RICE. Also, anything that materially affects unit economics (cost/token >10%) gets automatic escalation to product leadership.
lucy: Can we bake in customer-facing docs about rate-limit behavior and grace/burst logic? It's the main source of support tickets.
devx-bot: I'll draft a skeleton doc template and example FAQs.
product-bot: Action items captured: Maria -> finalize playbook, Ajay -> estimate infra effort for reserved MVP, Lucy -> get pilot contracts, Samir -> run ARR sensitivity. Due EOD next Wed (1795728256).
maria: Thanks all — this gives me enough to write the PRD. We'll use RICE as canonical for big work, quick impact/effort for smaller asks, and sequence pricing launches to reduce risk. More follow-ups in the PRD thread.
